cases.sentence: На 36-м году правления Ассы, царя ___, Бааша двинулся на земли Иудеи.
cases.translation: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha moved against the lands of Judah.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession: царя Иуды (king of Judah).

cases.sentence: Асса взял серебро и золото из сокровищниц ___ дома.
cases.translation: Asa took silver and gold from the treasures of the Lord's house.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses possession: сокровищниц Господа дома (treasures of the Lord's house).

cases.sentence: Асса послал ___ Арама серебро и золото.
cases.translation: Asa sent the king of Aram silver and gold.
cases.explain: The indirect object of the verb послал (sent) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он был в такой ярости, что бросил его в ___.
cases.translation: He was in such a rage that he threw him into prison.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with the accusative case indicates direction into a location.

cases.sentence: Ты положился на ___ Арама, а не на Господа.
cases.translation: You relied on the king of Aram, but not on the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb положился (relied on) with the preposition на (on) in the accusative expresses the object of reliance.

cases.translation: They captured cities in the land of Naphtali.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the prepositional case indicates location.

cases.sentence: Они вынесли из рамы камни и дерево, которыми строил Бааша из ___ Израиля.
cases.translation: They removed from Ramah the stones and timber with which Baasha had built from the land of Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Ben Hadad agreed with the proposal of King Asa.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession or relationship: предложением царя (the king's proposal).

reading.ru: На 36-м году правления Ассы, царя Иудеи, Бааша, царь Израиля, двинулся на земли Иудеи и укрепил раму, чтобы никто не мог ни войти во владение Ассы, царя Иудеи, ни покинуть их.
reading.question: What did Baasha do to Judah during the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign?
options: He attacked Judah, built Ramah, and blocked entry and exit from Asa's territory
He sent ambassadors to make peace with Asa
He captured Jerusalem and took Asa prisoner
He formed an alliance with Egypt against Judah
reading.correct: He attacked Judah, built Ramah, and blocked entry and exit from Asa's territory
reading.explain: The text states that Baasha двинулся на земли Иудеи и укрепил раму, чтобы никто не мог ни войти ни покинуть.

reading.ru: Асса взял серебро и золото из сокровищниц Господнего дома и своего дворца и послал царю Арама Винодаду, который правил в Дамаске.
reading.question: Where did Asa get the silver and gold he sent to Ben Hadad?
options: From the treasures of the Lord's house and his own palace
From tribute paid by neighboring nations
From the spoil taken in battle
reading.correct: From the treasures of the Lord's house and his own palace
reading.explain: The text explicitly says: Асса взял серебро и золото из сокровищниц Господнего дома и своего дворца.

reading.ru: Пусть между мной и тобой будет союз, как он был между нашими отцами.
reading.question: What kind of relationship did Asa want with Ben Hadad?
options: A treaty similar to the one between their fathers
reading.correct: A treaty similar to the one between their fathers
reading.explain: Asa says: Пусть между мной и тобой будет союз, как он был между нашими отцами.

reading.ru: Так как ты положился на царя Арама, а не на Господа твоего Бога, войско царя Арама спаслось от твоей руки.
reading.question: According to Hanani, why did the army of the king of Aram escape?
options: Because Asa relied on the king of Aram instead of on the Lord
Because the Aramean army was stronger than Judah's
Because God was angry with Asa for building the altar
reading.correct: Because Asa relied on the king of Aram instead of on the Lord
reading.explain: The prophet Hanani says: Так как ты положился на царя Арама, а не на Господа твоего Бога, войско царя Арама спаслось.

reading.ru: Ведь глаза Господа осматривают всю землю, чтобы укреплять тех, чьи сердца всецело преданы ему.
reading.question: What do the eyes of the Lord do throughout the earth?
options: They look throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are wholly devoted to Him
They search for sinners to punish them
They guard the temple from enemies
reading.correct: They look throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are wholly devoted to Him
reading.explain: The text states: глаза Господа осматривают всю землю, чтобы укреплять тех, чьи сердца всецело преданы ему.

reading.ru: На 39-м году правления у Ассы началась тяжелая болезнь ног, но даже в болезни он не искал Господа, а понадеялся на помощь лекарей.
reading.question: What disease did Asa develop in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, and where did he seek help?
options: A severe disease in his feet, and he sought help from physicians instead of from the Lord
A disease of the eyes, and he prayed to the Lord for healing
A plague that spread throughout Judah, and he sacrificed to God
A mental illness that made him unfit to rule
reading.correct: A severe disease in his feet, and he sought help from physicians instead of from the Lord
reading.explain: The passage says: у Ассы началась тяжелая болезнь ног, но даже в болезни он не искал Господа, а понадеялся на помощь лекарей.
